# WorldViewLink

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/view/world_view.h`](../../../src/view/world_view.h) · Described in `data/view.json`

On a host entity made by WorldView: the world body or shape it draws.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `world` | `uint32_t` | world index |
| `entity` | `entt::entity` | entity in that world's registry |

## Notes

Created and destroyed by WorldView only (its own map is what it reads); lets other code tell mirrored entities apart.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: —. Written by: WorldView. Created by: WorldView. Destroyed by: WorldView.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [WorldView](../systems/WorldView.md) | system | Host | **readwrite+create+destroy** | tick, finish | which world and entity the host entity draws |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[WorldView](../systems/WorldView.md)**
  - Uploads generated capsule meshes to the GPU through ModelManager::add (Transfer), once per size.
  - Creates and destroys host entities as bodies appear and go; destroys all of them in finish.
